departments.name: Computer Science
departments.school: School of Mathematics, Statistics & Computer Science
departments.summary: The Department of Computer Science (DCSC) offers UG-PG integrated, M.Sc. CS, M.Sc. AI, and Ph.D. programmes designed for global excellence.
departments.vision: The Department of Computer Science at CUSB is committed to research-led teaching in foundational and applied computing. With a curriculum aligned to NEP 2020 and industry requirements, students gain expertise in algorithms, artificial intelligence, data science, and software engineering — preparing them for careers in technology and research across India and globally.
departments.intake_info: B.Sc.: 25 seats · M.Sc. CS: 40 seats · M.Sc. AI: 20 seats

departments.name: Mathematics
departments.school: School of Mathematics, Statistics & Computer Science
departments.summary: The Department of Mathematics builds strong foundations in pure and applied mathematics for teaching, research, analytics, and scientific computing.
departments.vision: The department focuses on mathematical reasoning, modelling, analysis, and problem solving. Students engage with classical theory and modern applications across computation, finance, data analysis, and interdisciplinary research.

departments.name: Statistics
departments.school: School of Mathematics, Statistics & Computer Science
departments.summary: The Department of Statistics prepares students in statistical theory, applied data analysis, survey methods, and computational statistics.
departments.vision: The department connects rigorous statistical foundations with real-world data problems in science, social research, policy, industry, and technology.

departments.name: Bioinformatics
departments.school: School of Earth, Biological & Environmental Sciences
departments.summary: The Department of Bioinformatics blends biology, computer science, and statistics to study biological data at scale.
departments.vision: The department supports interdisciplinary learning in genomics, computational biology, biological databases, and data-driven life science research.

departments.name: Geology
departments.school: School of Earth, Biological & Environmental Sciences
departments.summary: The Department of Geology studies earth materials, processes, resources, hazards, and environmental change.
departments.vision: The department develops field-based and laboratory skills for understanding the Earth system, natural resources, geohazards, and sustainable development.

departments.name: Geography
departments.school: School of Earth, Biological & Environmental Sciences
departments.summary: The Department of Geography explores physical landscapes, human environments, spatial planning, and geospatial technologies.
departments.vision: The department combines fieldwork, spatial analysis, GIS, remote sensing, and social-environmental inquiry to understand changing regions and communities.

departments.name: Life Science
departments.school: School of Earth, Biological & Environmental Sciences
departments.summary: The Department of Life Science provides broad training in biological systems from molecules to ecosystems.
departments.vision: The department encourages laboratory learning and research across cell biology, microbiology, plant sciences, animal sciences, and ecology.

departments.name: Biotechnology
departments.school: School of Earth, Biological & Environmental Sciences
departments.summary: The Department of Biotechnology applies biological knowledge to health, agriculture, environment, and industrial innovation.
departments.vision: The department integrates molecular biology, genetics, bioprocessing, and modern laboratory practice for research and technology-oriented careers.

departments.name: Environmental Sciences
departments.school: School of Earth, Biological & Environmental Sciences
departments.summary: The Department of Environmental Sciences studies environmental systems, pollution, conservation, and sustainable resource management.
departments.vision: The department prepares students to address environmental challenges through field studies, laboratory analysis, policy awareness, and interdisciplinary research.

departments.name: Psychological Sciences
departments.summary: The Department of Psychological Sciences studies behaviour, cognition, development, mental health, and human well-being.
departments.vision: The department combines theory, assessment, research methods, and applied practice to prepare students for counselling, research, and human service roles.

departments.name: Historical Studies
departments.summary: The Department of Historical Studies examines societies, cultures, institutions, and ideas across time.
departments.vision: The department promotes critical historical inquiry through archival work, interpretation of sources, regional history, and wider global perspectives.

departments.name: Law & Governance
departments.summary: The Department of Law & Governance studies legal systems, constitutional values, public institutions, and justice.
departments.vision: The department combines legal education, governance studies, research, advocacy skills, and public service orientation.

departments.name: Chemistry
departments.summary: The Department of Chemistry studies matter, reactions, materials, analysis, and chemical processes.
departments.vision: The department develops experimental and theoretical understanding across organic, inorganic, physical, analytical, and materials chemistry.

departments.name: Physics
departments.summary: The Department of Physics investigates matter, energy, materials, space, and fundamental laws of nature.
departments.vision: The department combines theory, experiments, computation, and instrumentation to prepare students for research and technology careers.

hostels.name: Gargi Sadan & Maitreyi Sadan
hostels.description: The girls hostels provide comfortable and safe lodging for postgraduate and research students. Managed by a dedicated female warden team, it boasts robust security measures, a modern common room with a TV, daily newspaper service, and clean dining services.
hostels.common_facilities: Common Room, TV, Reading Room, Gym, Wi-Fi

hostels.name: Aryabhatta Sadan & Malviya Sadan
hostels.description: The boys hostels offer secure, spacious, and student-friendly accommodation. The rooms are double-sharing, well-ventilated, and furnished with a bed, table, and wardrobe. Facilities include an outdoor playground, high-speed Wi-Fi, indoor games, and clean drinking water units.
hostels.common_facilities: Table Tennis, Badminton Court, Wi-Fi, TV Lounge
hostels.mess_system: Student-run mess committee, Weekly menu reviews

chatbot_faq.response_en: You can apply for the 2026–27 academic session through the CUET-UG/PG or NCET portals. Visit the Admissions Portal at https://cuet.samarth.ac.in/ or click the "Apply Now" action on our site.
chatbot_faq.response_hi: आप सीयूईटी-यूजी/पीजी या एनसीईटी पोर्टल्स के माध्यम से शैक्षणिक सत्र 2026-27 के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं। प्रवेश पोर्टल https://cuet.samarth.ac.in/ पर जाएं या हमारी साइट पर "अभी आवेदन करें" पर क्लिक करें।

chatbot_faq.response_en: CUSB offers 51+ programmes including Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD degrees across multiple schools. Check our detailed offerings at courses.html.
chatbot_faq.response_hi: सीयूएसबी कई संकायों में स्नातक, स्नातकोत्तर और पीएचडी डिग्री सहित 51+ कार्यक्रम प्रदान करता है। विस्तृत जानकारी के लिए courses.html देखें।

chatbot_faq.response_en: CUSB provides secure hostels on campus: Gargi Sadan & Maitreyi Sadan for girls, and Aryabhatta Sadan & Malviya Sadan for boys. Each has modern double-sharing rooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, dining, security, and common rooms. Fees and wardens directory are available at hostel.html.
chatbot_faq.response_hi: सीयूएसबी परिसर में सुरक्षित छात्रावास प्रदान करता है: लड़कियों के लिए गार्गी और मैत्रेयी सदन, और लड़कों के लिए आर्यभट्ट और मालवीय सदन। प्रत्येक में आधुनिक डबल-शेयरिंग कमरे, वाई-फाई, डाइनिंग और सुरक्षा है। विस्तृत जानकारी hostel.html पर है।

chatbot_faq.response_en: CUSB is located on a sprawling 300-acre permanent green campus at Gaya-Panchanpur. It features smart classrooms, high-tech labs, a central library with thousands of electronic resources, open gyms, sports complexes, and a medical clinic.
chatbot_faq.response_hi: सीयूएसबी गया-पंचानपुर में 300 एकड़ के विशाल हरित परिसर में स्थित है। इसमें स्मार्ट कक्षाएं, हाई-टेक लैब, केंद्रीय पुस्तकालय, ओपन जिम, स्पोर्ट्स कॉम्प्लेक्स और एक स्वास्थ्य क्लिनिक शामिल है।

chatbot_faq.response_en: You can reach us at our helpdesk number 0631-2229 530 or via email at info@cusb.ac.in. The physical address is SH-7, Gaya-Panchanpur Road, Gaya - 824236, Bihar, India.
chatbot_faq.response_hi: आप हमसे 0631-2229 530 पर या info@cusb.ac.in पर ईमेल द्वारा संपर्क कर सकते हैं। पता है: एसएच-7, गया-पंचानपुर रोड, गया - 824236, बिहार, भारत।

chatbot_faq.response_en: Students can pay academic fees online through the Samarth student portal at https://cusb.samarth.edu.in/. For detailed course fee structure brochures, check the Downloads tab or our Academics section.
chatbot_faq.response_hi: छात्र समर्थ छात्र पोर्टल https://cusb.samarth.edu.in/ के माध्यम से शैक्षणिक शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान कर सकते हैं। विस्तृत शुल्क संरचना के लिए डाउनलोड टैब देखें।
